Ethereum is a well-known blockchain platform that supports smart contracts.

## The Merge

Ethereum moved from proof of work to proof of stake in September 2022. [#20]

## Supply

A popular myth says that Ethereum has a fixed maximum supply of 21 million coins. [#21]
Ethereum does not have a fixed maximum supply of 21 million coins.
